about: Brief A step 1 (2026-10-24): facing_stops.json's stops with a signed facing, read from each walk's decode. signed_deg is clockwise as Jay turns, seen from above: 0 = facing the phone, 90 = turned right (the phone on his left), 180 = away, 270 = turned left (the phone on his right). Each stop is [t0, t1, unsigned_deg, signed_deg, how]. signed_deg is null where the decode doesn't say which way he turned; those are batched for Jay in results/rotation/colour/report.md. 'said' = the callout names it; 'sequence' = the walk's other callouts force it (each turn the same way); 'inferred' = the most likely reading, not forced.

rooms.note: kitchen walks are library.json's room tag; the others have no tag. 125621 walks 'towards the kitchen' and 221126 runs the 1-8 m ladder, so both are taken as the living room; 122038 and 171645 are taken with them. 030615 calls itself 'a small room' and is left out of the per-room reference.
